speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You walk like Grandfather.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Like this. The shoulder comes first. The foot finds the place the shoulder promised.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Show me again. Thou hast his shoulder.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Yours is worse. His stops at the shop door. Yours has come up the road.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: How many miles?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hundred.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: A hundred will do. I can keep a hundred. I do not need them one by one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hundred, then. From London to this bridge.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Susanna has been at the parapet since dinner. She said she was passing. She is still here.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: She looked at your feet. I looked at the arches. There are fourteen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen, and the water is low. The miles are a hundred. That is the number thou art having.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Walk to the parapet and back. I want the shoulder once more, so I have it right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more. Then I am done walking for show.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: There. That is Grandfather, if Grandfather had been on a road. I have it.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I said I am content. A hundred is a good keep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art content, and she has the walk. The pack goes off my back at this end.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: I have the pack. Give it here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take it. The awkward one is the flat parcel, in the oilcloth.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: It rides on top. Under the cloak it creases. On the side it knocks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On top, then. Not under.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: On top, and the cloak outside it, so the flat one stays flat.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The shoulder, once more, from here to the parapet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more. Then I am done showing it.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I have a hundred. I am not spending them.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: On top. I have the pack from this end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the hundred. The flat parcel rides on top. Richard has it.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: On top. I have it.
